subject: Deployment window & ownership exchange for production handover
messages:
From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@acme-health.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-health.com
Cc: Susan Lee <susan.lee@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T16:22:00-04:00
Subject: Request: final deployment runbook and handover call

Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to lock in the final production handover and want to run through the deployment window, rollback/fallback owners, and validation checklist with your team. Procurement also needs to confirm the cutover window so they can trigger the payment milestone in DocuSign.

Can we schedule a 60-minute call with Redwood AE/SE, our platform engineers, procurement, and security for next week? Preferred windows (all EDT): Tue 4/13 08:00–09:00, Wed 4/14 10:00–11:00, or Thu 4/15 14:00–15:00. Please confirm availability and the deploy runbook you’ll reference.

Also, please include a short fallback matrix and who owns each step (application rollback, DB restore, routing rollback).

Best,
Emma
Emma Torres
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Health Systems
[Attachment: network_diagram_acme.pdf]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Torres <emma.torres@acme-health.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: final deployment runbook and handover call

Thanks Emma — we can take this.

Proposed call windows (PDT):
- Wed 4/14 10:00–11:00 PDT (18:00–19:00 UTC) — our preferred
- Tue 4/13 08:00–09:00 PDT — possible but limited on ops coverage
- Thu 4/15 14:00–15:00 PDT — backup

I’m attaching our latest deploy plan (redwood_deploy_plan_v2.pdf) and a draft fallback matrix (kv_fallback_matrix.xlsx). Karthik will run through the checklist during the call. Marcus will own post-cutover verification if anything needs escalation.

Please confirm which window works for procurement and security. If none, tell us the earliest slot you can commit to and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_deploy_plan_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: kv_fallback_matrix.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-09T18:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: final deployment runbook and handover call

Quick note from the SE side —

If we lock Wed 4/14 10:00 PDT, I’ll allocate a standard runbook walkthrough plus a 20-minute dry-run of the KV cache failover path (that’s where we’ve seen the most variance). Could you confirm the primary platform engineer who will be on the call and whether we’ll have test credentials for a pre-cutover smoke test?

Also calling out items I’d like on the agenda:
- Cutover command sequence (who runs which commands)
- KV cache population check and prewarm window
- Rollback triggers and who is authorized to execute
- Post-cutover verification checklist and SLA rollback window

If you can drop the engineer name and security contact, I’ll add them to the invite.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Emma Torres <emma.torres@acme-health.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-health.com, Rajiv Menon <r.menon@acme-health.com>, Susan Lee <susan.lee@acme-health.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: final deployment runbook and handover call

Lauren / Karthik —

Procurement pushed back on Wed evening windows; they prefer Tue 4/13 at 08:00 EDT (08:00–09:00 EDT) to align with the quarterly payment run. Our security lead Rajiv Menon (cc’d) also asked to be available for the 08:00 slot.

Primary attendees from Acme: Rajiv Menon (Security), Susan Lee (Platform Ops), and myself. We can provide a short test account for a smoke run, yes — Susan will drop the credentials in a follow-up email.

If Redwood cannot cover Tue morning, we’ll escalate to our Director to adjust the payment Milestone. Let us know asap.

Emma

Marcus Lin

All —

We agreed to keep the Tue 4/13 08:00 EDT window to accommodate procurement. Thank you, Emma, for pushing that. Logistics below: 

Call: Tue 2027-04-13 08:00–09:00 EDT (05:00–06:00 PDT) — dial-in details and calendar invite to follow.
Owners (primary / backup):
- Cutover operator: Aditya Rao (primary), Marcus Lin (backup)
- DB migration guard: Karthik Iyer (primary), Aditya Rao (backup)
- Network routing rollback: Lauren Bishop (primary), Marcus Lin (backup)
- Post-cutover verification: Susan Lee (Acme) / Marcus Lin (Redwood)

Agenda:
1) Quick roll-call & go/no-go checklist
2) Step-by-step cutover commands (Karthik)
3) KV cache prewarm and validation (Karthik)
4) Simulated rollback scenario (15m)
5) Acceptance criteria and SLA trigger points

Attachments: redwood_deploy_plan_v2.pdf, kv_fallback_matrix.xlsx, network_diagram_acme.pdf

If anyone on the Redwood side cannot make 05:00 PDT, please confirm now; we’ll book an internal brief at 04:15 PDT to ensure coverage.

Lauren Bishop
